origin: Independently written bounded adaptation of Yogar EX1 fib_safe-6.i. Eight additions per worker instead of six, local loop indices, joins before observation, and the equivalent constant F(18). P0 injects a one-unit bias into the left update.
thread_bound: Exactly two workers, one creation per worker; eight iterations per worker.
property: After both joins neither component exceeds Fibonacci number F(18) = 2584.
assumptions: Both components start at one; each addition is atomic; fixed size unsigned arithmetic has no overflow for these values.
intent: Remove the left additive bias while preserving both eight-iteration workers.
harness_replacements: Eight atomic additions are bounded by F(10).
Sixteen atomic additions are bounded by F(18).
